content: Official ISRO MOSDAC & IMD Synoptic Bulletin: Severe convective clouds concentrated over Gangetic West Bengal. Precipitation rate 25-35 mm/hr. Waterlogging hazard critical for low-lying municipal wards.

NDMA Urban Flood Protocol: High-tide lockage active at lockgates. Avoid all underpasses. Citizens in water-inundated ground floors must shift vertically to higher stories and signal emergency teams via 112.
